text: Undergraduate applications open on October 1st and close on January 15th each year. Applicants must submit high school transcripts, two letters of recommendation, and a personal statement through the online portal. There is no application fee for students applying for financial aid.
Transfer students must have completed at least 24 credit hours at their previous institution with a minimum GPA of 2.5. Transfer applications are reviewed on a rolling basis starting in March.
The Fall 2026 semester begins on August 24th and ends on December 12th. Final exams are held during the week of December 8th to 12th. The add/drop deadline is September 4th.
The Spring 2026 semester begins on January 12th and ends on May 8th. Spring break runs from March 16th to March 20th. The withdrawal deadline without academic penalty is April 3rd.

Tuition for full-time undergraduate students is billed per semester and is due two weeks before the start of classes. Students may enroll in a monthly payment plan through the Bursar's Office with no additional interest, provided enrollment happens before the semester billing deadline.
A late payment fee of $75 is applied to any balance not paid by the due date. Students with unpaid balances over $500 may have a hold placed on registration for the following semester.

Students who miss a final exam due to a documented medical or family emergency may request a makeup exam by submitting a request to the Registrar's Office within 5 business days of the missed exam, along with supporting documentation.

Academic dishonesty during an exam, including unauthorized materials or communication with other students, results in an automatic grade of zero for that exam and referral to the Academic Integrity Board.

First-year students are required to live in on-campus housing unless they are commuting from a parent or guardian's residence within 25 miles of campus. Housing applications for the following academic year open in February.
Residence halls close for winter break on December 13th and reopen on January 10th. Students needing to stay during the break must submit a Winter Housing Request at least two weeks in advance.

The main library is open 24 hours during finals week and from 8am to midnight during the regular semester. Students can borrow up to 15 books at a time for a 3-week loan period, renewable twice if no one else has requested the item.

The Career Services office offers free resume reviews, mock interviews, and career fairs each fall and spring semester. Students can book a one-on-one advising appointment through the student portal under the Career tab.
